On 17 March 2026 the governor of Haut-Uélé handed Starlink satellite internet kits to 45 chiefdoms and sectors and 6 territories, following the recommendations of the 2025 forum on security governance.
The Starlink kits were handed to the entities by the governor of Haut-Uélé province on 17 March 2026, the provincial government being the only provider the report names.

The Digital Transformation Project unit issued a tender notice on 4 June 2026, financed by a World Bank credit and AFD co-financing, to connect administrative buildings of 7 governorates and 44 territories in a pilot phase over a GovNet VPN, with bids due 16 July 2026.
The pilot connection tender is financed by World Bank credit 7602-ZR and an AFD co-financing agreement, with no domestic budget line stated.

Congo Quotidien reports that the Digital Transformation Project Management Unit (UG PTN) opened an international tender to connect administrative buildings of seven governorates and 44 territories in a pilot phase, via low-orbit satellite links and a GovNet VPN to Kinshasa.
The tender is run by the UG PTN, which reports to the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications and the Ministry of Digital Economy.
The lot is financed by the World Bank (credit 7602-ZR) and co-financed by the Agence Française de Développement.
